checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: stream header-only reads for episode/claim verification

impact_assessment.why: Verification parsed and retained every action record just to find headers; a 100k-record log cost 124.2 MB peak.
impact_assessment.benefits: read_headers retains only headers; measured 0.1 MB peak vs 124.2 MB and 4.019 s vs 5.715 s, with identical results and errors.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive Telemetry method; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Match read_all whitespace/JSON behavior, add tests and a 100k battery, use it in both verifiers, rerun 438 tests plus AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional per-record HMAC and keyed rotation for calibration

impact_assessment.why: Calibration records were checksum-only; a rewritten record with a recomputed checksum passed, and rotating a keyed journal was undefined.
impact_assessment.benefits: A caller-held key authenticates each record including its checksum; keyed rotation preserves records and scores; wrong keys fail.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional store kwargs, record gains optional mac; dependency: stdlib hmac; concurrency: unchanged lock; state: optional field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Exclude mac from the checksum, keep unkeyed records byte-compatible, verify before writes, test keyed/wrong/missing/tampered/rotation, rerun 443 tests.

[1/4] Plan: refuse unkeyed writes over keyed evidence

impact_assessment.why: Unkeyed append/rotation over a keyed calibration journal and unkeyed save over a keyed claim store silently downgraded or mixed authenticated evidence.
impact_assessment.benefits: All three write paths refuse the downgrade and leave the file byte-identical; keyed reads still load.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: store-level guards only; dependency: none; concurrency: guards run under the existing lock; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Guard append, rotation live/archive, and save; test byte equality and keyed reload; rerun 449 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: pass a calibration HMAC key through the logged-run bridge

impact_assessment.why: The bridge could not pass the journal HMAC key, so a keyed journal could not be appended through a real run.
impact_assessment.benefits: calibration_hmac_key appends keyed records through a run; wrong/invalid keys fail before the log; default behavior unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one optional kwargs pair on run_task_logged; dependency: calibration_store; concurrency: unchanged lock; state: optional MAC field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate bytes/path before the run, pass to append_forecasts, test keyed/wrong/no-path/invalid, rerun bridge and full suites.
